title: Donald W NDE 22230
content: Just after they smashed my face with a rock, I felt myself raising from a horizontal position and slowly rising from the surface to an upright position. Floating, so it seemed, completely aware of what was happening. Although I could see nothing I could feel every part of my body down to my waist. Although in the dark I seemed to know which way was forward or backward. In essence, gravity and three dimensions seemed to still be in play. I noticed an utter peace and feeling of non-concern and was of a blissful state I will never forget. I was fully aware what was happening to me and then I thought of my soon to be wife, asleep at Kona Shores waiting for me to come home and I remember asking myself what she would do now. At that very second I felt myself being forced back to where my body was lying and I entered into it so hard my body actually bounced off the concrete.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Criminal attack Life threatening event, but not clinical death Although I wasn't aware of it at the time.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm My sight was nocturnal. I could see without seeing. I looked at my arms and just knew they were there. The sense of touch was greatly enhanced.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Never concerned, but I didn't understand.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control It only lasted fifteen to twenty seconds.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: ome to you? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Anger, lack of patience and not trusting of people.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Anger, lack of patience and not trusting of people. After the NDE
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: There was no worst part. The best was the feeling of utter peace and contentment.
